description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveRequestDao class, which manages database operations related to leave requests, leaves, entitlements, and leave statuses within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and processing leave data, handling transactions, and querying with various filters.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing leave request related database operations, including creation, updating, retrieval, and complex querying within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Persists a leave request along with linked leave entries and entitlement adjustments within a database transaction.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Saves a leave request comment, setting creation timestamp if null.

methods.name: saveLeave
methods.description: Persists a leave entity to the database.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a leave, optionally removing linked entitlements and applying entitlement changes atomically.

methods.name: getOverlappingLeave
methods.description: Retrieves leaves of an employee that overlap with a specified date range, considering partial days and times if provided.

methods.name: getTotalLeaveDuration
methods.description: Calculates total leave hours for an employee on a given date, considering only relevant leave statuses.

methods.name: getLeaveById
methods.description: Fetches a leave record by its ID.

methods.name: markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Triggers marking all approved leaves as taken up to the current date.

methods.name: _markApprovedLeaveAsTaken
methods.description: Private method that updates leaves with status 'approved' to 'taken' if their date is before the current date, avoiding multiple executions.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRangeQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query for employee leave requests filtered by employee number and optional date range.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsByEmpNumberAndDateRange
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests for an employee within an optional date range.

methods.name: getLeavesByEmpNumberAndDates
methods.description: Fetches leaves of an employee matching specific dates.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a leave request by ID.

methods.name: getLeavesByLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Fetches leaves associated with a particular leave request.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatuses
methods.description: Returns all available leave status entities.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leaves based on search filter parameters, with automatic approval marking.

methods.name: getLeavesCount
methods.description: Counts leaves matching specific filter criteria.

methods.name: getLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves leave requests based on search filters, with automatic approval marking.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsCount
methods.description: Counts leave requests matching search filters.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for leave request queries with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: getLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for leaves with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves leaves for a specific employee with filtering.

methods.name: getEmployeeLeavesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for employee leaves with filters.

methods.name: getUsedLeaveTypeIdsByEmployee
methods.description: Returns distinct leave type IDs used by an employee within an optional date range.
